entries.final_answer: Seed on the coordination branch at create
options: Seed on the coordination branch at create
Reconcile the target-side copy at consolidate
entries.question: How should a coordination mission's status log stay off the target branch: seed it on the coordination branch at create, or let consolidate reconcile a target-side copy?
entries.rationale: Self-driven per the operator's instruction (thread request 2026-10-01: 'Self-drive as much as you can, based on the charter'). Seeding fixes the defect at its source (issue #5440's primary expected outcome), matches the existing coord fixture shape (STATUS-only husk), and also removes the first-coord-write carry-over gap. Reconciling at consolidate would leave the CLI writing a COORD-partition kind onto the target and only paper over it later.
